policy.rule: Resolve by canonical subject identity, not by legacy label similarity alone.

resolutions.rationale: Canonical definition is a wheeled platform used to move materials or tools; this matches the legacy Platform cart subject.
Canonical entry explicitly describes secondary waterproof roof underlayment beneath roofing.
The alternate candidate is a concrete groover for control joints, which is a different tool from the legacy pointing-trowel subject.
Canonical entry is explicitly Strut Channel used to support piping or equipment.
Canonical entry is Japanese Plane, a hand plane used to smooth wood surfaces; the legacy kana spelling refers to the same tool.
Canonical entry is a ridge vent that exhausts attic heat or moisture; this matches the legacy roof-vent subject.
Canonical entry covers 木鏝・フロート used to level mortar or concrete surfaces.

The legacy Japanese term たがね denotes a striking chisel for hard material; q012_cold_chisel is the canonical タガネ for cutting or chipping metal or concrete, while the generic chisel candidate is explicitly a woodworking chisel (のみ).
q011_flashing is the roof/component canonical for 水切り / Flashing that directs water away from joints; it is more specific than the generic basic material entry.

The legacy 唐草 / Drip edge subject is a roof-edge water-shedding component; q014_drip_edge is the roof-component canonical, whereas the alternate drip_edge entry also spans sills, copings, and exterior transitions.
q013_paint_tray explicitly defines the roller paint tray used to load paint onto a roller and is the higher-quality canonical match for the legacy subject.
q011_notched_trowel exactly matches くし目ごて / Notched Trowel and explicitly defines the notched adhesive-spreading tile tool.
The safety_harness canonical explicitly names 墜落制止用器具(フルハーネス) and includes Full-Body Harness as an English alias, establishing exact subject identity.

holds.reason: Legacy Japanese says separator while English says form tie; q011_form_tie and q011_separator are distinct formwork components, so image identity cannot be narrowed safely.
